# NRSC / ISRO Bhuvan Thematic WMS Layers

- **Endpoints**:
  - `https://bhuvan-vec2.nrsc.gov.in/bhuvan/wms`
  - `https://bhuvan-ras2.nrsc.gov.in/cgi-bin/LULC250K.exe`
- **Layers**:
  - `LULC 1:50K / 1:250K`
  - `Wastelands Atlas of India (2019)`
  - `Urban Land Use`
  - `Water Bodies`
  - `Salt Affected & Waterlogged Soils`
- **Use**: Reference verification and visual cross-validation against cadastral points.
- **Access**: Open WMS OGC GetMap / GetFeatureInfo requests with polite caching.
